title: MusicManager_PlaylistUsesSafeEndDetection
stepsToReproduce: Open MusicManager_Nathan.cs:~69; start a race and let a track finish
expectedBehaviour: Playlist advances to next track reliably
actualBehaviour: Exact float equality 'musicSource.time == 0' used for end-of-track detection, unreliable, playlist may never advance

title: ColourBlindFilter_DontDestroyOnRoot
stepsToReproduce: Attach ColourBlindFilter to a child GameObject; enter Play Mode
expectedBehaviour: DontDestroyOnLoad only called on root GameObjects
actualBehaviour: DontDestroyOnLoad(gameObject) called without checking transform.parent == null, Unity logs an error if called on a non-root
notes: Add 'if (transform.parent != null) transform.SetParent(null);' before the call

title: RaceManager_P1P2EqualForwardDistanceOnGrid
stepsToReproduce: Load Main scene in split-screen mode; observe P1 and P2 starting positions
expectedBehaviour: P1 and P2 start at equal forward distance, offset only laterally
actualBehaviour: P1 and P2 are 29.30m apart along the forward axis, unfair advantage
notes: Check startOffset multiplier in SetupStartingGrid() for P2

title: TrafficSpawner_NoInfiniteSpawnWithoutRace
stepsToReproduce: Load Main scene; do NOT start the race; wait 5 seconds
expectedBehaviour: Traffic only spawns after race reaches Racing state
actualBehaviour: 5 traffic vehicle(s) spawned despite race not reaching Racing state, indicates spawn coroutine runs unconditionally
notes: Add a RaceState.Racing check at the top of the traffic spawn coroutine
